decisions.reason: Both the shipped row and blind target 0 identify the same tested original study: Baron, J., & Hershey, J. C. (1988), 'Outcome bias in decision evaluation', Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 54(4), 569. The conflicting_dois pairing flag arises only because the article's reference list prints a double slash in the DOI ('10.1037//0022-3514.54.4.569') whereas the shipped record uses the normalized single-slash DOI ('10.1037/0022-3514.54.4.569').

decisions.quote: For the replication (pre-registered) part of the study, we successfully replicated signal and direction of the outcome bias (original: d paired = 0.21 – 0.53; replication: d independent = 0.77 [0.62, 0.93] to 1.1 [0.94, 1.26]), and even for participants who stated that outcomes should not be taken into consideration when evaluating decisions ( d = 0.64 [0.21, 1.08]).
decisions.reason: The authors state an explicit overall replication verdict that the pre-registered replication successfully replicated the signal and direction of the outcome bias in both physician and patient conditions as well as among participants who stated that outcomes should not be taken into consideration. Additional tests of outcome importance, responsibility, and perceived norms as mediators are explicitly framed as new extensions rather than failures of the original study.
